{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the 'revenue' column: strip whitespace and replace '0.00' strings explicitly
sales_df['revenue'] = sales_df['revenue'].str.strip()

# Check for any hidden characters or non-breaking spaces in '0.00' strings
# Look at the first few characters of the problematic rows
problematic_rows = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].str.contains('0.00', na=False)]

# Extract the raw bytes of the '0.00' string in the first problematic row
raw_bytes = problematic_rows.iloc[0]['revenue'].encode('utf-8')
raw_bytes"}
